messages:
danielle: Heads up — CI shows a spike in SAST failures after the RBAC cleanup merged last night. A bunch of jobs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied.
sec-bot: alert: scan-runner fail_ratio=0.24 increase=+20% recent_error="KMS:AccessDeniedException" link: https://ci.internal/runs/18821
owen: I saw ~30 failing PRs. Looks like scanner now assumes `infra-scan-role` and the KMS key policy still lists the old SA principal.
mina: sample log: `2024-06-05T02:04:12Z scan ERROR artifact_unwrap id=gh-31415 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::555555555:assumed-role/infra-scan-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555555555:key/fff1-2222`
julio: Can we soft-fail the scan job so merges aren't blocked? Prefer not to turn off scanning.
infra-oncall: Created soft-fail waiver WAIV-20240605-03 for 90m. Keep channel updated before expiry.
carla: Short-term mitigation: add the assumed-role ARN to the key policy in staging, run decrypt smoke, then roll to prod. I'll patch staging now.
danielle: Also several SAST findings look like false positives from the new `hex-literal` rule catching generated code. We should add a small suppression whitelist for `gen/**`.
owen: Carla, please confirm the exact ARNs needed. I'll prepare a minimal key policy statement adding both `arn:aws:iam::555555555:role/infra-scan-role` and `arn:aws:sts::555555555:assumed-role/infra-scan-role/*`.
carla: Staging patch applied. Smoke decrypt: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/fff1-2222 --profile staging-scan` -> success.
mina: Re-ran subset of failures in staging: artifact unwraps fixed. SAST noise remains for two repos.
julio: Action list: 1) keep soft-fail (infra-oncall) 2) prod key-policy patch after staging validation (carla) 3) add CloudTrail alert for `kms:Decrypt` AccessDenied spikes (owen) 4) open small SAST config PR to suppress `gen/**` and lower severity for `hex-literal` (danielle) 5) add a preflight in infra PR template to detect KMS key policy references when changing principals (mina).
sec-bot: incident created: id=INC-20240605-04 "scan-fail-kms-policy-mismatch" link: https://inc.internal/INC-20240605-04
carla: Prod key-policy patched and decrypt smoke against archived artifact passed. Re-ran blocked PRs; most are unblocked.
danielle: I'll file a short postmortem and add the RBAC->KMS checklist to the scan runbook. Also will link infra preflight ticket.
mina: Agree — long-term fix is infra CI preflight and a runbook checklist. Thanks everyone for quick triage.
